label: RB951Ui-2HnD
description: MikroTik RB951Ui-2HnD (RB951Ui-2HnD) — 5x 100M RJ45, Wi-Fi 2.4 GHz. MIPSBE 1-core AR9344.
notes: Power method from the mikrotik.com spec table: **PoE in: Passive PoE** (8-30 V) on `eth1`; **PoE out on `eth5`** - it powers the device above it on the mast or the AP on the wall, and the port is the vendor's own, not a convention. Input is recorded on the first Ethernet port because the table states the method and voltage but does not name the port, and every MikroTik with a PoE-IN DC input takes it there. Max power consumption 24 W.
